mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM ( NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID, NOTIFICATION_GUID, SUBSCRIBER_GUID, PUSH_TIMESTAMP, ITEM_EXPIRY_TIMESTAMP, ITEM_IDENTIFIER, REVISION_COUNT, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIMESTAMP, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIMESTAMP ) SELECT uuid_generate_v1(), n.notification_guid, n.subscriber_guid, #{pushTimestamp, javaType=java.util.Date, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP, mode=IN}, #{itemExpiryTimestamp, javaType=java.util.Date, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP, mode=IN}, #{itemIdentifier, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}, 1, COALESCE ( #{userId, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN} , current_user), current_timestamp, COALESCE ( #{userId, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN} , current_user), current_timestamp FROM public.notification n JOIN public.notification_settings ns ON ns.subscriber_guid = n.subscriber_guid WHERE n.active_ind = 'Y' AND ns.notification_token != '' AND ST_INTERSECTS(n.point_geom_buffered, )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.notification_topic nt WHERE nt.notification_guid = n.notification_guid AND nt.notification_topic_name = #{topic, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN} ) ON CONFLICT (NOTIFICATION_GUID, ITEM_IDENTIFIER) DO NOTHING

WITH claimed AS ( UPDATE NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM npi SET SENT_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp, UPDATE_TIMESTAMP = current_timestamp WHERE npi.NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID IN ( SELECT c.NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID FROM NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM c WHERE c.ITEM_IDENTIFIER = #{itemIdentifier, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN} AND c.SENT_TIMESTAMP IS NULL AND (c.SUBSCRIBER_GUID, c.NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID) > (#{afterSubscriberGuid, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}, #{afterPushItemGuid, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}) ORDER BY c.SUBSCRIBER_GUID, c.NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID LIMIT #{pageSize, javaType=java.lang.Integer, jdbcType=INTEGER, mode=IN} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) RETURNING npi.NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM_GUID, npi.NOTIFICATION_GUID, npi.SUBSCRIBER_GUID ) SELECT claimed.notification_push_item_guid AS "notificationPushItemGuid", claimed.notification_guid AS "notificationGuid", claimed.subscriber_guid AS "subscriberGuid", n.notification_name AS "notificationName", NULLIF(btrim(n.longitude), '')::double precision AS "longitude", NULLIF(btrim(n.latitude), '')::double precision AS "latitude", n.radius_kms AS "radius", ns.notification_token AS "notificationToken" FROM claimed JOIN public.notification n ON n.notification_guid = claimed.notification_guid JOIN public.notification_settings ns ON ns.subscriber_guid = claimed.subscriber_guid
ORDER BY claimed.subscriber_guid, claimed.notification_push_item_guid
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM WHERE ctid IN ( SELECT ctid FROM NOTIFICATION_PUSH_ITEM WHERE ITEM_EXPIRY_TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL AND ITEM_EXPIRY_TIMESTAMP < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LIMIT #{limit, javaType=java.lang.Integer, jdbcType=INTEGER, mode=IN} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED )
